apps.name: WorkHub
apps.subtitle: Inspections and ECC Daily Hand In
apps.localizedDescription: Native, local-first iPhone inspections and ECC Daily Hand In. Direct Google Drive access, PDF preview, native PDF merging, and ZIP exports. Distributed as an unsigned IPA for sideloading.
apps.versionDescription:
Added: Rotate individual uploaded PDF or image pages 90° left or right in PDF Multi Tool, including Rotate controls in page menus and the full-page preview.
Updated: PDF thumbnails, preview and final merged export reflect each page's independent rotation; source PDFs stay unchanged.
Added: Left/right rotation controls for individual Daily JHA photos, including camera and Photos library imports.
Updated: Daily JHA export supports mixed portrait and landscape PDF page sizes rather than forcing every photo onto a portrait sheet.
Added: Automated rotation regression tests and output orientation checks.
Unchanged: Inspections, Today dashboard, Google Drive and sideloader workflows remain intact.

versions.localizedDescription:
Added: Rotate individual uploaded PDF or image pages 90° left or right in PDF Multi Tool, including Rotate controls in page menus and the full-page preview.
Updated: PDF thumbnails, preview and final merged export reflect each page's independent rotation; source PDFs stay unchanged.
Added: Left/right rotation controls for individual Daily JHA photos, including camera and Photos library imports.
Updated: Daily JHA export supports mixed portrait and landscape PDF page sizes rather than forcing every photo onto a portrait sheet.
Added: Automated rotation regression tests and output orientation checks.
Unchanged: Inspections, Today dashboard, Google Drive and sideloader workflows remain intact.

Fixed: The Browse search field now sits beneath the Browse / Today / Daily JHA switch, preventing the switch from jumping downward when opening Browse.
Improved: A compact inline search box provides a clear button and keeps the navigation bar at a constant height.
Unchanged: Fuzzy name/date search remains available in Browse only. Today dashboard, Daily JHA drafts, inspection caches and appearance settings are preserved.

Added: A new Today tab inside Inspections with a dashboard of PDFs filed in today's dated Google Drive inspection folders.
Added: Live total, Harness/Lift and ECC/CAMH breakdown cards, per-source counts, and preview/share access to today's PDFs.
Improved: A dedicated lightweight lookup checks only today's folders, caches its results for five minutes, and preserves previously saved data if Google Drive is temporarily unavailable.
Added: Appearance options to hide the Today tab or open the field-work screen directly to Today.
Unchanged: Bulk inspections use their 24-hour cache; Daily Hand In, PDF Multi Tool, and existing appearance settings are preserved.

Fixed: Inspections by day no longer groups and sorts all date folders every time the screen redraws; daily totals and display dates are precomputed once and saved with the 24-hour local index.
Improved: Folder PDF count badges now use constant-time lookups instead of scanning every date folder.
Improved: The daily breakdown shows seven days initially, with older dates added in small batches to keep navigation responsive.
Added: An automated large-catalog regression test covering 1,344 folders, 6,720 PDFs, cross-source daily counts, and migration of existing cached indexes.
Unchanged: Inspections by day remains optional in Appearance. Google Drive, Daily Hand In, offline caching, and PDF Multi Tool are preserved.

Updated: Complete inspection metadata and folder listings persist locally; automatic refresh checks run every 24 hours while WorkHub is active or when reopened.
Added: Optional full offline PDF downloads with progress, resume and storage safeguards.
Fixed: Bulk inspection search appears only in Browse, never on Daily Hand In.
Added: Appearance controls for search, dashboards, per-folder counters and cache maintenance.
Fixed: Sideloader version history now uses accurate, distinct Added/Updated/Fixed/Removed notes for every prior release.

Added: Local fuzzy inspection search by PDF name, partial words and multiple date formats.
Added: PDF counters per date folder, per source and across the full inspection directory.
Added: Daily totals combined across ECC/CAMH sources.
Updated: Metadata indexing uses batched Drive requests with progress and caching.

Added: Appearance Studio with 12 preset accent colors, custom HEX and theme controls.
Added: Reorderable bottom tabs, startup-tab choices and screen-density options.
Added: PDF grid/list, filename visibility and Daily Hand In layout customization.
Added: Focused, Balanced and Detailed appearance presets.

Fixed: Files document imports using a reliable copy-mode iOS document picker.
Updated: PDF reordering uses native drag handles in a dedicated Pages/Whole Files list.
Merged: Inspections and Daily Hand In into one field-work tab.
Added: Appearance settings for themes, accents, module visibility and page density.
Removed: Redundant Google Drive banners and source-folder clutter from the default screens.

Added: Dedicated PDF Arrange mode with numbered thumbnails and improved page movement.
Added: Whole-file reordering, Undo and precise page-move controls.
Updated: PDF workspace layout emphasizes page order during rearrangement.

Added: Small, Balanced and High image-compression presets for new PDF workspace images.
Updated: Images are downsampled and JPEG-compressed before conversion to PDF pages.
Added: Before/after size feedback when importing images.

Added: Add Pages menu with Select File, Select Image from Photos and Take Image using Camera.
Updated: Photos and camera captures enter the same PDF page stack as file imports.

Added: Native PDF Multi Tool with a combined multi-document page workspace, thumbnails, page selection and preview.
Added: Cross-document page ordering and custom-named merged PDF export.
Updated: PDF and image imports are processed locally.

Added: Daily Hand In ZIP on/off output choice.
Added: Copy three separately named inspection/JHA PDFs to the iPhone clipboard with a success toast.
Updated: ZIP mode automatically opens the iOS export sheet.

Removed: Google Drive browsing through the iOS Files picker and manual inspection PDF imports.
Updated: Inspections and Daily Hand In use direct authorized Google Drive access.
Added: Branded hardhat/checklist iPhone Home Screen icon, also used by the sideloader feed.

Fixed: AltStore/SideStore feed compatibility by including legacy top-level app fields and the supported privacy-permissions format.
Unchanged: The WorkHub app features match build 17.

Added: Native Google Drive inspection browsing for ECC and CAMH Harness/Lift folders, PDF preview/share and local caching.
Added: ECC Daily Hand In with camera/photo JHA pages, date-based inspection PDFs and three-PDF ZIP exports.
Updated: All PDF processing runs on the iPhone, without a WorkHub server.
